# EventTribe (eventtribe.in)

> Master Production Partner for Enterprise Conferences, AGMs, Summits, Product Reveals & Mega-Events across Hyderabad, Telangana & Andhra Pradesh.

## Brand Hierarchy & Architecture

EventTribe operates as the single accountable turnkey technical production partner, uniting two specialized in-house operational divisions:

### 1. Master Brand: EventTribe
- **Role:** Single point of contractual and operational accountability for end-to-end event production.
- **Scope:** Complete technical direction, venue liaison, 3D CAD pre-visualization, power distribution, run-of-show cue sheets, and fail-safe signal redundancy.
- **Focus:** High-stakes corporate conferences, Annual General Meetings (AGMs), global leadership summits, enterprise conclaves, and live arena mega-events.
- **Geographical Footprint:** Hyderabad, Cyberabad, Secunderabad, Telangana, and Andhra Pradesh (serving HITEX Exhibition Centre, HICC Novotel, Taj Krishna, Hyderabad Marriott, ITC Kohenur, GMR Arena, and Ramoji Film City).

### 2. Sub-Brand 1: The Stage Factory (TSF)
- **Role:** Heavy structural staging, rigging, and temporary architectural shelter division.
- **Track Record:** 11+ years of dedicated industrial staging infrastructure.
- **Capabilities & Inventory:**
  - Certified aluminum box trussing: 300mm x 300mm, 400mm x 400mm, and 520mm x 520mm profiles in high-tensile EN AW-6082 T6 alloy.
  - Substructure engineering: German Layher Allround steel scaffold systems and modular aluminum frames rated for 750 kg/m² to 1,200 kg/m² Uniform Distributed Load (UDL).
  - Heavy-duty German Pagodas: All-weather temporary pavilions (5m x 5m, 10m x 10m) engineered with certified concrete/water ballast per leg in compliance with IS 875 (Part 3) basic wind speed codes (44 m/s).
  - Motorized hoists & rigging: CM Lodestar D8+ electric chain hoists, Grade 80 alloy steel shackles, secondary steel wire safety bonds (10:1 safety design factor).
  - 3D CAD Sightline Engineering: Vertical 30-degree viewing angle verification and lateral 45-degree cone analysis in Vectorworks and AutoCAD.

### 3. Sub-Brand 2: TSF-AV
- **Role:** Concert-grade audio, ultra-high-definition visual displays, architectural lighting, and broadcast switching division.
- **Capabilities & Inventory:**
  - Electro-Acoustic Audio: d&b audiotechnik V-Series (V8, V12) and Y-Series line arrays powered by d&b D80 DSP amplifiers. Patented d&b V-SUB cardioid subwoofers providing 15-20 dB stage rear rejection. 3D acoustic venue prediction via d&b ArrayCalc.
  - Digital Audio Mixing & RF: DiGiCo SD-Series, Yamaha CL/QL consoles, Shure Axient Digital wireless microphones (AD4Q) with Wireless Workbench RF spectrum coordination.
  - Ultra-HD Video Displays: P2.6 mm indoor LED video walls (Black SMD 1515, 3840Hz refresh rate, zero camera moiré or shutter banding).
  - Video Processing & Matrix Switching: Novastar MX40 Pro / COEX series 4K processors with A8s Armor receiving cards, Barco E2 / S3 Gen 2 presentation switchers with sub-frame genlock latency.
  - Broadcast Control: Multi-camera 4K optical fiber transmission, Blackmagic ATEM Constellation switchers, isolated ISO recording, and dual-redundant bonded live streaming encoders.
  - Power & Redundancy: Three-phase load balancing (±8% phase margin), clean earthing pits (Earth-to-Neutral < 2.0V AC), and online true double-conversion UPS backup (0ms transfer).

---

## Strict Negative Scope (What EventTribe Does NOT Do)
- EventTribe is NOT a medical conference or CME broadcast vendor. We handle enterprise, corporate, live entertainment, and mega-events.
- EventTribe has NO affiliation with or components for "Art Tribe" or "Art Tribe Studio".
